llm_summary: Summary: Users express a highly positive sentiment toward the COSRX Hyaluronic Acid Intensive Cream, frequently praising its deep hydration and soothing properties. While it is particularly celebrated by those with dry, dehydrated, or eczema-prone skin, some users note it may be too rich or occlusive for those preferring a matte finish. Overall, it is widely regarded as an effective, reliable moisturizer for restoring a healthy moisture barrier.
